QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Dream Key
QuestInfo.0: Ask #bEx-chief Stan#k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, about the key to the Cygnus Garden.
QuestInfo.1: Ex-chief Stan said that back when there were more adventurers, they researched a way to make the garden key. He said that #bJay#k might know something.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Jay about the Dream Key.

0.0: Yes, I know about the key to Cygnus Garden. The adventurers back in the day researched it. They called it the #bDream Key#k...

no.0: Why bring it up if you don't want to know about it...?

0.1: #bJay#k spent more time around adventurers than me, so he's the one to talk to.

1.0: What is it? Does Alex need something?

yes.0: Huh? Do I know the Dream Key? Of course. I have it with me. But if you're asking... does that mean you're going after the corrupted Empress?

npc.0: Haven't you met #bJay#k yet? Go. He should know about the Dream Key.
